text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come across Silence Suzuka talking to
Air
Groove and what appears to be a
younger
student.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What happened? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You could say that. I promised this
student here
that I'd supervise her
practice session, but
student council
matters have suddenly come up.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, d-don't worry! I'll just go through my
usual
routine, so I'll be okay training on
my own!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...How do you normally practice?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm currently working towards my goal
race, so
I'm trying to improve my running
form and
stamina while also reading up
on training theory!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
If I want to dominate the races, I have to
make
sure to completely fix my weak
spots! So...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Can I ask you something? Is
winning the
whole reason you run?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh... I'm sorry. I was just wondering.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Well, I mean... yes, o-of course it is! As a
student
of Tracen Academy, it's
imperative that I show
results!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
My times have gotten better already...
and, uh...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Um, if it's okay with you, Air Groove...

Maybe I could oversee her training in
your place?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What? Suzuka, you're offering to help?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't get me wrong. It's just...
interesting. Haha...
I'll take you up on
that offer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Okay then, shall we get started? For
today's
training...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You'll need to catch me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Understood! ... ...Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Sh-she's way too fast! N-no amount of training theory or pacing are gonna close this gap!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I-I'm spent!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: H-how does she look so relaxed?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Argh! I'm not done yet! I can keep on
going!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huh?! Where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, what does it matter?! I just have to
run! Run
run run RUN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The younger Umamusume bolts out of
the
academy grounds chasing after
Silence Suzuka.
Hardly a shred of theory
can be observed in her
running form.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And yet strangely enough, she seems to
be
enjoying herself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you've finally returned. I was
wondering
where you'd gone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...In any case, what happened? The both
of you
look startlingly satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So? What did you think of the scenery
during the
run?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Th-the scenery? Um... Well, after a
certain point,
I stopped having stray
thoughts, and...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...It felt great. It was so fun to just be
running.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That's great. It looks like what I
wanted to
teach you got across.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
In all the races I've run... that's the only
thing I've
ever wanted to convey.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Kind of a labored way to get your
point
across, but I guess that's Suzuka
for you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Didn't expect you'd volunteer to lead
the next
generation, though... Heh-heh.
How you've
changed...
